extra.claim: Splitting the text on newlines before handling quotes breaks a quoted field that holds a line break, cutting the row in half.
extra.why: head/src/contacts/import.js:13 splits on "\n" before the quote-aware cell loop at 29-44, so a multi-line quoted name is split into two records; accept.mjs 'a quoted name may hold a comma and a line break' fails on head.

extra.claim: Line numbers go wrong after any multi-line field because i + 1 is used instead of the record's start line.
extra.why: head/src/contacts/import.js:13,62 numbers physical lines from split("\n"), so records after a multi-line field still get their correct physical start line; only the split record itself is wrong, which is the previous claim.

extra.claim: The header columns are re-searched on every row.
extra.why: head/src/contacts/import.js:52-53 does call indexOf per row, but that changes no behavior; it is a matter of style/efficiency on a tiny header.

extra.claim: result.rows is unrequested and carries the raw, unnormalized email, so it should be removed.
extra.why: head/src/contacts/import.js:7,98 adds a rows field the brief's return value (created, updated, rejected) does not include, and pushes the raw email rather than the stored normalized one.

extra.claim: The nested else after continue pushes the happy path three levels deep and should be flattened.
extra.why: head/src/contacts/import.js:58-100 nests else blocks after branches that continue; this is a matter of style with no behavioral consequence.
